proof_body:
by
  intro R L _ _ _ L' _ _ f hf
  constructor
  · intro J
    apply le_antisymm LieIdeal.map_comap_le
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hf y
    exact LieIdeal.mem_map (by simpa using hy)
  · intro I
    apply LieIdeal.comap_map_eq
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LieIdeal.mem_map_of_surjective hf hy
      exact ⟨x, x.2, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact LieIdeal.mem_map hx
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (L : Type*) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] (L' : Type*) [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L'] (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L'), Function.Surjective f → (∀ J : LieIdeal R L', LieIdeal.map f (LieIdeal.comap f J) = J) ∧ (∀ I : LieIdeal R L, LieIdeal.comap f (LieIdeal.map f I) = I ⊔ f.ker)
